pages.text: {{hero}} has a pet dinosaur from the swamp. It has a long neck and a soft, thick tum. {{hero}} and the pet stomp and romp in the sun.
{{hero}} wants to swim in the pond with the pet. The pond is past the rocks and the tall grass. {{hero}} jumps on the pet's back, and off they go.
But a log is stuck on the path. It is big and thick. The pet can not get past it. {{hero}} pushes, but the log will not shift.
Then the pet lifts the log with its long neck. Thump! The log rolls off the path. {{hero}} hugs the pet. Then they swim and splash in the pond.
At dusk, {{hero}} is snug in bed. But at the pond, in a nest of sticks, sits a big egg with spots. What will hatch from it?
